body:
PR #1221 has merged to main as `1b3e88d45aa886edd72206e8a7c31ca6f28a8d83`. It is not released yet.

Native apply contexts now expose the additive `IMvApplyTableBindings` capability with an immutable per-invocation `OwnTables` map and `TryGetPhysicalName`. Fresh projectors can obtain their own resolved physical names without running `InitializeAsync` in verification mode. Projectors that cache initialization-only table handles need to adopt this lookup; no stored-data migration is required. Existing interfaces and VerifyOnly / VerifyAndExecute safety boundaries remain unchanged.

Independent exact-head Opus5 review passed. CI executed 12 PostgreSQL and 12 SQL Server regression cases on each of net9/net10, with zero skips, covering fresh-instance application, checkpoints, negative verification controls and both apply routes. The updated EN/JA documentation explains adoption and the capability’s scope.

Release remains deferred while the agreed backlog is handled; keeping this source issue open for release tracking.
